title: Six section-7 rows record as 'not retained' flags that are current production defaults
method: Read the binder in hipengine/generation/qwen4_exp_profiles.py and checked each named flag's binding against the production branch. No inference from names or comments.
finding: Every one of the six flags is bound to '"1" if production else "0"' and is therefore live in the production profile.

rows.recorded_reason: failed canonical depth after the recovery
part of the failed recovery composition

settled_case.shipped: GR up KL <= 7.4e-8 with 100% top-1 and +9.2% prefill geo-mean; GR down KL <= 5.5e-8 and +2.0% on top
settled_case.source: binder comments in hipengine/generation/qwen4_exp_profiles.py immediately above each binding
settled_case.discrepancy: five orders of magnitude in KL
settled_case.explanation: the promoted mechanism is a different one (three-plane fp32 staging); the row's own reopen condition, 'A structurally different mechanism', was met
settled_case.consequence: no win is left here - the gains are already in production - but the record is wrong

systemic_defect: Every section-7 row carries a 'Reopen only with' condition and nothing in the repository evaluates whether one has been satisfied. A row can be correct when written, superseded by later work, and still read as a rejection by anyone consulting the table - which is the table's only purpose.
consequence_for_the_census: Section 7 is a candidate SOURCE, not only a graveyard. The retained multi-column GDN win (1.34x-1.68x) was found by asking whether a recorded rejection still held.
not_established: Whether the Q8 MMQ depth failure was later resolved or the flag was restored without a re-gate.
Whether the PRODUCTION_MOE_PREFILL/Q4_IU8_PREFILL task-gate rejection of 2026-09-30 coexists with both flags enabled by design or by drift.
Whether any of the three association-withdrawn rows holds a further win.
limits: One profile (production, gguf_ud_q4_k_xl), one host (gfx1151), static reading of the binder. No timing was run for this artifact.
